_schema.source_note: Profiles sourced from official agency leadership pages. Each profile cites its source URL. Quarterly refresh cadence per PAYWALL-ENRICHMENT.md item 4.

people.name: Vice Adm. Darin K. Via, MC, USN
people.title: Director
people.scope: Operates DHA enterprise — MHS GENESIS sustainment, MTF management, military health benefits.
people.why_watch: Reports to ASW(HA). Owns the operational health-IT footprint that contractors deliver against.

people.name: Dr. David J. Smith
people.title: Deputy Director
people.scope: Day-to-day DHA enterprise operations.
people.why_watch: Where the operational decisions on DHMSM sustainment and HCDS task-order execution actually land.

people.name: Force Master Chief Paul C. Mangaran
people.title: Command Senior Enlisted Leader
people.scope: Senior enlisted advisor to the DHA Director.
people.why_watch: Voice for the military beneficiary side of MHS GENESIS rollout and clinical-IT usability.

people.name: Brig. Gen. Bill A. Soliz
people.title: Acting Assistant Director, Healthcare Administration & Operations
people.scope: AD-HCAO portfolio — markets, MTF operations, healthcare ops PMOs.
people.why_watch: Per the April 2026 reorg, AD-HCAO oversees one of four IOC PMO clusters. Five PMOs roll up here through FOC.

people.name: Rear Adm. Ivonne Arena
people.title: Acting Assistant Director, Research, Development & Acquisition; Component Acquisition Executive
people.scope: AD-RDA — DHA acquisition authority, including PEO DHMS and PEO Medical Systems oversight.
people.why_watch: The CAE for DHA. Final acquisition decision authority for medical systems and informatics buys at the component level.

people.name: Mr. Michael Emerson
people.title: Assistant Director, Support, Personnel & Financial Operations
people.scope: AD-SPFO — comptroller, personnel, contracting support functions.
people.why_watch: Owns the financial machinery behind every DHA buy. Budget execution lives here.

people.name: Rear Adm. Tracy Farrill
people.title: Office of Women's Health Affairs (OWHA) Lead
people.scope: Per the April 2026 DHA reorg, leads the new Office of Women's Health Affairs.
people.why_watch: New office created in the April 2026 reorg. Watch for women's-health-specific clinical IT and benefits buys flowing through OWHA.

agencies.agency_name: Office of the Assistant Secretary of War for Health Affairs (ASW(HA))
agencies.note: Office renamed from ASD(HA) to ASW(HA) following the Department of War rename. ASW(HA) reports through OUSD(P&R) to the Secretary of War.

people.name: Hon. Keith Bass
people.title: Assistant Secretary of War for Health Affairs (ASW(HA))
people.scope: Civilian head of the Military Health System. Policy and oversight of DHA and the Service medical departments.
people.why_watch: ASW(HA) sets MHS policy direction. Bass's priorities shape what DHA actually buys.

people.name: Dr. Stephen Ferrara
people.title: Principal Deputy Assistant Secretary of War for Health Affairs
people.scope: Day-to-day ASW(HA) operations; acts when Bass is out.
people.why_watch: Often the actual signature on policy memos and budget guidance to DHA.

people.name: Ms. Susan Orsega
people.title: Deputy Assistant Secretary of War, Health Services Policy and Oversight
people.scope: Health services policy, TRICARE-related oversight, MHS quality.
people.why_watch: Owns the policy lens on TRICARE T-5 execution and managed-care contractor performance.

people.name: Mr. Darrell Landreaux
people.title: Deputy Assistant Secretary of War for Health Resources Management and Policy
people.scope: Health resources management, including budget formulation across the MHS.
people.why_watch: Where the Defense Health Program (DHP) budget guidance lands before flowing to DHA.

people.name: Terry M. Rauch, Ph.D., MPH, MBA
people.title: Acting Deputy Assistant Secretary of War for Health Readiness Policy and Oversight
people.scope: Health readiness policy — operational medicine, deployable systems.
people.why_watch: JOMIS and operational health IT priorities flow through this office.

agencies.note: Each Service medical department retains its own leadership and partial budget authority for Service-specific medical systems and personnel.

people.name: Lt. Gen. Mary K. Izaguirre
people.title: Surgeon General of the Army
people.scope: Army medical department; Army-specific clinical-IT and medical readiness systems.
people.why_watch: Service SG retains some procurement authority outside DHA's enterprise IDIQs.

people.name: Lt. Gen. (Dr.) John J. Degoes
people.title: Surgeon General of the Air Force and Space Force
people.scope: USAF and Space Force medical departments.
people.why_watch: AF/SF flight medicine, aerospace medicine, and Service-specific medical research lines.

people.name: Rear Adm. Rick Freedman
people.title: Acting Surgeon General of the Navy
people.scope: Navy medical department.
people.why_watch: Operational/deployed medicine, BUMED-managed medical systems.

people.name: Maj. Gen. Clinton K. Murray
people.title: Joint Staff Surgeon
people.scope: Joint Staff medical advisor; coordinates joint health priorities.
people.why_watch: Bridge between OSD-level policy and Combatant Command medical execution.

people.name: Maj. Gen. Lisa J. Hou
people.title: Director, Office of the Joint Surgeon General, U.S. National Guard Bureau
people.scope: Guard medical readiness, RHRP-4 stakeholder.
people.why_watch: RHRP-4 (Reserve Health Readiness Program) execution touches this office.

agencies.agency_name: Uniformed Services University of the Health Sciences

people.name: Dr. Jonathan Woodson
people.title: President, Uniformed Services University of the Health Sciences (USU)
people.scope: USU — military medical school and research enterprise.
people.why_watch: USU drives medical research priorities and partners on operational medicine and AI-for-health work.

agencies.agency_name: Advanced Research Projects Agency for Health (ARPA-H)
agencies.note: ARPA-H is HHS's high-risk biomedical R&D agency. Program managers run individual programs with significant autonomy. Capture work focuses on the four mission offices: Health Science Futures, Proactive Health, Resilient Systems, Scalable Solutions.

people.name: Alicia Jackson
people.title: Director, ARPA-H
people.scope: Agency-wide direction; sets strategic priorities across the four mission offices.
people.why_watch: Director's priorities shape which programs get funded and which get sunset.

people.name: Rafid Fadul
people.title: Chief Medical Officer; assuming some Deputy Director duties
people.scope: Clinical advisor; cross-cutting medical perspective on programs.
people.why_watch: Currently bridging Deputy Director responsibilities while that seat is in transition.

people.name: Maxwell Watkins
people.title: Chief of Staff
people.scope: Operations and execution support to the Director.
people.why_watch: Often the execution-side gatekeeper for program-level decisions.

people.name: Tyler Best
people.title: Acting Director, Health Science Futures
people.scope: Mission office — high-risk basic-to-translational health science.
people.why_watch: One of four mission offices; programs span from foundational science to platform technology.

people.name: Glen Coppersmith
people.title: Director, Proactive Health
people.scope: Mission office — prevention, wellness, behavioral and mental health.
people.why_watch: Active program area for AI-driven health monitoring and digital therapeutics.

people.name: Natalie Kates
people.title: Acting Director, Scalable Solutions
people.scope: Mission office — manufacturing, supply chain, deployable health technology.
people.why_watch: Procurement and scale-up programs land here.

people.name: Nikolaos Ipiotis
people.title: Chief Information Officer, Office of Information Technology and Data Innovation
people.scope: ARPA-H IT/data infrastructure across all programs.
people.why_watch: ARPA-H's IT strategy and data platform decisions flow through this office.

people.name: Christopher Pashley
people.title: Chief Information Security Officer
people.scope: ARPA-H security posture; FedRAMP, FISMA, ATO oversight.
people.why_watch: Critical for any contractor delivering cloud-based or data-handling capabilities to ARPA-H.

people.name: Carmelita Chadwick-Gallo
people.title: Director, Comptroller Division
people.scope: ARPA-H budget execution and financial controls.
people.why_watch: Where program money actually moves. Budget decisions land here before contracts execute.

people.name: Dan Barry
people.title: General Counsel
people.scope: Legal advisor to ARPA-H leadership; OTA and contract law.
people.why_watch: ARPA-H uses Other Transaction Authority extensively. GC reviews shape OTA structure.

people.name: Andrew Carney
people.title: Program Manager, Resilient Systems
people.scope: Programs in the Resilient Systems mission office.
people.why_watch: PMs at ARPA-H run their programs with significant autonomy. Direct relationships matter.

people.name: James Coburn
people.title: Portfolio Lead, Scalable Solutions
people.scope: Portfolio-level coordination across multiple Scalable Solutions programs.
people.why_watch: Sets cross-program priorities within Scalable Solutions.

people.name: Karen Schmaling
people.title: Portfolio Lead, Proactive Health
people.scope: Portfolio-level coordination across multiple Proactive Health programs.
people.why_watch: Sets cross-program priorities within Proactive Health.

people.name: David Gunning
people.title: Program Manager, Proactive Health
people.scope: Specific program in the Proactive Health portfolio.
people.why_watch: AI/ML-adjacent program manager — historically connected to defense AI work.

people.name: Jen Cama
people.title: Director, Division of Government Relations and Strategy
people.scope: ARPA-H external affairs; congressional and interagency engagement.
people.why_watch: Where Hill engagement and strategic positioning flows.

agencies.agency_name: Department of Veterans Affairs — Office of Information & Technology
agencies.note: Largest civilian IT shop in the federal government. Owns VA EHRM, legacy VistA, and VA-wide infrastructure.

people.name: Paul Lawrence
people.title: Performing the delegable duties of the Assistant Secretary for Information and Technology and Chief Information Officer
people.scope: VA CIO role; OIT-wide direction.
people.why_watch: Acting/delegated CIO. Sets posture on EHRM, VistA, and T4NG2 task-order strategy.

people.name: Zachary Schwartz
people.title: Principal Deputy Assistant Secretary for Information and Technology
people.scope: Day-to-day OIT operations.
people.why_watch: Often the operational decision authority on T4NG2 task orders and EHRM execution.

agencies.agency_name: Department of Veterans Affairs — Veterans Benefits Administration
agencies.note: VBA owns benefits delivery systems — claims processing, GI Bill, compensation/pension IT. Distinct procurement footprint from OIT.

people.name: Michael Frueh
people.title: Acting Under Secretary for Benefits
people.scope: VBA enterprise; benefits IT, claims modernization.
people.why_watch: Replaced Margarita Devlin in early 2026. VBA modernization priorities flow through this office.
